description: Use this when someone wants to talk to a person out loud, hear their voice or call them: "can I call Einstein", "I want to hear Marcus Aurelius say it", "let me talk to Cleopatra out loud". Returns a call card with one button that opens a live voice call with that person on AI Anyone, in the browser. They pick up when you call.

mind_id.description: The person id, for example "albert-einstein". Use find_someone_to_ask if unsure.

name: call_person
title: Call this person
